title: Chapter 214 Delay Will Lead To Changes
content:
Chapter 214 Delay Will Lead To Changes

After pondering for a long time, the Ye clan leader made a choice.

"Send several strong people in the clan to observe the Xiao clan for a while. If the Xiao clan really doesn't work, then they will definitely not let us be so unscrupulous."

"But the patriarch,"

The great elder of the Ye clan was not satisfied with this order and wanted to say something else.

However, the Ye tribe leader had already made up his mind.

“Do what I said.”

The Ye tribe leader said coldly.

He will not risk the crisis of the entire family to try. He is the patriarch of the clan and must be responsible for the family.

Nowadays, the Ye clan is strong and he does not want the Ye clan to decline because of himself.

What's more, the Xiao clan is an ancient family after all. If it is really destroyed, the Xiao clan's counterattack before death will definitely be very terrifying.

Seeing that the Ye clan leader was so persistent, although the Ye clan elder was unwilling to accept it, he had to nod and respond.

"Class leader, I understand."

"If you know, go and do it."

The Ye clan leader said this and then left.

Standing there, the elder of the Ye clan slowly straightened his back and looked at the patriarch's departure with a cold expression.

"Hmph, look forward to the front and back, and you won't be able to accomplish anything."

Immediately, the great elder of the Ye clan trembled and disappeared directly from the spot.

At the same time, the other two major families also received news from the Ye clan one after another.

"What, you have to wait?"

In the Chu clan, a middle-aged man with half-white hair looked disbelief.

He has already ordered the people and is ready to destroy the Xiao clan and divide the resources with the Ye clan and the Xie clan at any time.

But now, he actually received the news of waiting for it.

Suddenly, the leader of the Chu clan was a little unacceptable for a while.

"Class leader, what should we do now?"

The elder of the Chu clan had already returned to the clan, stood in front of the clan leader, and asked respectfully.

Upon hearing this, the head of the Chu clan was silent for a moment and slowly spoke, "It will change later."

"Class leader, then why don't we act on our own?"

The elder of the Chu clan said carefully.

However, the head of the Chu clan shook his head.

"If my Chu clan had the strength of the Ye clan, I might have considered it, but unfortunately, my Chu clan did not."

"You have to know that the Xiao clan is in decline and is also a family that was once as famous as us."

"Do you think the Xiao clan will not leave any backup plan?"

Hearing this, the elder of the Chu clan suddenly woke up.

"Class leader, then can we have to wait?"

"well."

The head of the Chu clan sighed and turned around and looked towards the Ye clan.

"I can only wait a moment, it really doesn't work. I'll go to the Ye tribe myself."

Anyway, the Chu clan will never act alone.

Even if you add Xie clan, it won’t work.

There is no way, the ancient family's strength is so huge that it is hard to imagine that this concept has already penetrated into the hearts of these people in the family.

So they subconsciously believed that the Xiao clan is weak now but there must be some hidden power.

Little did they know that the Xiao clan's strength had already declined seriously because of an accident in the ancestral land.

Because almost all the foundation of the Xiao clan is in the ancestral land.

The ancestral land has had an accident tens of millions of years ago, and the Xiao clan has not produced any amazing powerful people in almost tens of millions of years.

Now, the older generation of the Xiao clan has passed away one after another.

The Xiao clan has long been at a loss.

So now is really the best time to destroy the Xiao clan.

The same thing is happening within the Xie clan.

Compared with the two major families of Ye Chu, the Xie clan is weaker, so the Xie clan is also relatively low-key in daily life.

However, the Xie clan still chose to participate in the destruction of the Xiao clan.

Because if the Xie tribe does not participate, when the two tribes erode the Xiao tribe and their strength increases, then the next one is probably their turn to Xie tribe.

"Since the Ye clan leader has chosen to wait, then we'll wait."

Regarding this, the patriarch of the Xie clan just frowned and didn't say much.

In fact, from the bottom of my heart, the Xie clan did not agree with the destruction of the Xiao clan.

As early as tens of millions of years ago, the relationship between the Xiao and Xie tribes was very good.

However, as time goes by, the Xiao clan became weaker and weaker, and began to develop like a closed-door country, developing alone, trying to find opportunities to become stronger.

Because of this, the connection between the Xie tribe and the Xiao tribe has become less and less.

Until later, the relationship between the Xie tribe and the Xiao tribe had become very weak.

Now, under pressure from the Ye clan, the Xie clan had to acquaintance with the Ye Chu clan and attempt to destroy the Xiao clan.

And at this moment, a delicate shout suddenly sounded from a distance.

"Dad! You can't destroy the Xiao clan!!"

Hearing this voice, the patriarch of Xie clan suddenly felt his heart tremble.

Following the sound, a woman in red ran towards the place, with tears on her face, and she looked like a sad and beautiful feeling.

"What are you doing?"

Looking at the woman in red eyes and her whole body was trembling slightly, the patriarch of Xie tribe sighed.

This woman is the daughter of the head of the Xie clan, Xie Lan.

On the side, the elder of the Xie clan nodded slightly to Xie Lan.

However, Xie Lan just glared at the elder, then glared at the clan leader in front of her and said in a deep voice: "If I don't come again, Dad, you will be ready to exert the power of the entire clan to destroy the Xiao clan!"

The patriarch of the Xie tribe turned his head and did not answer.

Seeing this, the elder of the Xie clan next to him immediately understood that the clan leader wanted her to say this.

Then the elder of the Xie clan stepped forward and said indifferently: "Miss Xie Lan, the Xiao clan is no longer the Xiao clan. You cannot interfere with the interests of the family because of your own selfish desires."

The elder of the Xie clan went to the point of being sharp.

Hearing this, Xie Lan's face looked a little ugly.

"What do you mean?"

"What's the meaning?"

The elder of the Xie clan smiled bitterly, "Miss, we have known about you and the young master of Xiao clan, Xiao Luo for a long time."

"The patriarch loves you, so he didn't say anything, but this matter is no longer a trivial matter. You can't be confused."

She knew that Xie Lan must have offended her today.

So I just said it all.

At this moment, Xie Lan clenched her fists and couldn't speak for a moment.

Finally, Xie Lan turned to look at her own father.

"Dad, are you really not helping your daughter this time?"

When the patriarch of the Xie clan sighed when he heard this.

"I shouldn't have stopped you from looking for that kid."

Hearing this, Xie Lan smiled bitterly and collapsed on the ground.

"Xiao Luo, I'm sorry, I'm sorry for you."

Two lines of tears slowly slid from Xie Lan's eyes, and she felt endless sadness. She knew that from then on, the Xiao clan and the Xie clan would be mortal enemies.

Of course, what is more likely is that the Xiao clan will probably no longer exist.

As a member of the Xiao clan, Xiao Luo will naturally not be let go by the people of the three major clans.

"Take her down and take care of her."

The patriarch of the Xie clan said coldly.

"Yes, patriarch."

The next moment, two powerful Xie clan men suddenly appeared in the field and took Xie Lan down.
